action: Open the default General space
user_goal: I want a starting place for ordinary questions
steps: Open Ask from the sidebar
Open Memory → Spaces
Return to Home
expected: General is selected by default
Memory has Profile, Spaces, Goals and Rules
General has no Rename, Archive or Delete controls
Ben still has ¥0 safe to spend and is ¥18,780 short on Nov 27 if clients pay late

action: Create a space
user_goal: I want a place for one task
steps: Open Memory → Spaces → New space
Enter "Tax for March" and choose Create space
expected: Ask opens at /canvas?space=<id> in Tax for March with an empty thread
General remains available and the space controls fit at 375px and 1440px

action: Rename a space
user_goal: I want the task name to reflect what I am doing
preconditions: An open space called "Tax for March"
steps: Note the space’s current URL
In Memory → Spaces, rename Tax for March to March paperwork
expected: The new name appears in Memory and Ask
The space has the same URL and keeps its thread

action: Ask in a task space and reopen it
user_goal: I want the task’s thread to stay separate
preconditions: An open space called "Tax for March"
steps: In Tax for March, ask "Can I afford ¥4,000 tonight?"
Open General
After ten minutes, reopen Tax for March and reload it
expected: The answer says ¥4,000 does not fit using Ben’s numbers
General does not show the question
Tax for March still shows its question and answer

action: Read a conversation from before spaces
user_goal: I want to find an earlier conversation
preconditions: A household with two stored conversations that predate spaces and migration 0030 applied
steps: Open General, then Earlier conversations
Open each legacy thread and return to General
expected: The legacy threads remain separate with their original turns
Legacy threads are read-only, and General can accept a new question

action: Archive a space
user_goal: I want a finished task out of the way and still readable
preconditions: A task space with a saved fictional turn
steps: Archive the space from Memory → Spaces
Check Ask’s open-space navigation
Open the space under Archived spaces
expected: It leaves the open lists
Its saved thread is available read-only

action: Delete a space with a document attached
user_goal: I want to remove the task and keep its uploaded file
preconditions: An expendable space with a saved turn, pinned canvas and attached fictional document
steps: Open Delete on the space and choose Keep
Open Delete again and confirm
Open Your data → Uploaded documents
expected: The confirmation explains what is removed and that attached documents stay
Keep leaves the space unchanged
Confirming removes the space and thread; the file still appears under Uploaded documents and the waiting reading opens in To check

action: Pin a canvas to a task space
user_goal: I want task canvases with that task
preconditions: An open space called "Tax for March"
steps: Choose Pin to this space on an Ask canvas in Tax for March
Open General and choose Pin to Home on a different canvas
Open Home, reload it, and then return to Tax for March
expected: Home draws the same General pin and numbers after reload
The task pin opens from Pinned in this space in Tax for March and is absent from Home

action: Export a space with its thread
user_goal: I want a copy of my tasks and conversations
preconditions: A task space with a saved fictional turn
steps: Check the Ask conversations count in Settings → Your data
Choose Export my data and inspect the JSON
expected: The cloud journal count includes the saved turn and the named space, and excludes General itself
The export is version 3, with General and the task in spaces
The saved turn’s conversationId equals the exported task’s id

action: Import spaces into an empty household
user_goal: I want my task threads back in a new household
preconditions: A version 3 export containing General, a task space and its thread
A fresh Start with my numbers household in the same currency
steps: Import the file under Settings → Your data
Open the imported task from Ask
expected: The task’s name and thread are restored
The task and thread use destination ids

action: Reach the open-space limit
user_goal: I want a clear result when I already have many spaces
steps: Run npm run db:spaces-test
expected: The household can keep 20 open spaces including General
The next create is refused and archiving frees a slot

action: Try to open another household’s space
user_goal: I want my spaces private to my household
preconditions: Two PGlite households with space fixtures
steps: Run npm run db:isolation-test and npm run db:spaces-test
expected: The tenant role sees no other household’s spaces
A request by another household cannot access or mutate the space

action: Delete a space and its saved context together
user_goal: I want deleting a task to remove its saved context
preconditions: A PGlite space with a thread, notes, pins, brief and attached documents
steps: Run npm run db:spaces-test
expected: One deletion removes the space, notes, thread, pins and brief
The household keeps the documents

action: Write the space brief by hand
user_goal: I want to keep the task goal where I can see it
preconditions: An empty space called March paperwork
steps: Open the space, choose Edit under Space brief
Enter About "Check the March paperwork" and Goal "Find the statement", then choose Save brief
Reload the space and check Memory → Spaces
expected: The empty brief initially says "No brief yet."
As soon as Save brief completes, the entered fields replace "No brief yet." alongside "Brief saved." and "You updated it" with a time
The fields persist after reload and the Spaces tab shows the first line of About
The editor fits at 375px and 1440px

action: Let Ask update the brief
user_goal: I want the facts we found to be visible next time
preconditions: An empty space called Card A review
steps: Ask "What is Card A’s next statement amount and due date? Update this space’s brief with what you find."
Open Space brief, reload, and check Activity
expected: The answer reports ¥58,000 due Nov 26
The brief updates and shows "Agent updated it" with a time
Any amount in the brief comes from this question’s tool results
Activity shows the update without the brief text

action: Follow up from the saved brief
user_goal: I want Ask to continue the same work after a break
preconditions: Card A review with its saved brief and a working model
steps: Close Ask and return to the same space after ten minutes
Ask "What should I check next for this statement?"
expected: The space brief is still visible
Ask continues the same task and reads current tool results before quoting money

action: Check amounts and cited notes in a proposed brief
user_goal: I want the space summary to keep verified amounts
preconditions: PGlite household with a saved brief and simulated model replies
steps: Run npm run db:agent-test
expected: An amount absent from this question’s tool results refuses the proposed update
The existing brief stays in place when an amount or source is invalid, and the trace contains only a fixed reason
A note from another space is accepted as a source after recall or search_history returns it

action: Fit a long thread and its document cards into the context
user_goal: I want a long-running task to keep the right context
preconditions: PGlite fixture with older turns and a document turn in the recent suffix
steps: Run npm run db:conversation-test and npm run db:agent-test
expected: The recent turns fit the 12,000-character budget with oldest turns omitted first
The document card for an included turn travels with the question and the earlier turns stay in the thread

action: Move the space brief to this device
user_goal: I want the saved brief to follow the journal
preconditions: A saved space brief in the cloud with at least one turn
steps: In Your data, move Ask conversations to this device
Reopen the space, edit its brief and reload
Open Memory → Spaces
expected: The turn, brief and update time are still visible after the move
The device edit survives reload and the Spaces list shows its updated About line

action: Export a device-only brief
user_goal: I want my export to include the brief on this browser
preconditions: Ask conversations is kept on this device
A space with a local saved brief
steps: Choose Export from this device and open the file
expected: The local brief and its update metadata appear on the matching space in the version 3 export

action: Move a device brief back to the cloud
user_goal: I want other devices to see my task brief again
preconditions: A device journal with a saved space brief
steps: Move Ask conversations back to our cloud
Reload the space
expected: The brief and its update time still appear after reload
The device’s journal and brief copies have been cleared

action: Delete a brief from a device journal
user_goal: I want to clear the work saved on this browser
preconditions: A device journal with a saved space brief and turn
steps: Delete the device’s Ask conversations under Your data
Return to the named space
Open Memory → Spaces and delete that space individually
expected: Your data explains that spaces are deleted one at a time in Memory → Spaces
Clearing the device journal leaves the space name and empties the thread and brief
Deleting the space individually removes its name

action: Add a note to a space
user_goal: I want the note to stay with this task
steps: Open March paperwork and choose Add a note under Space notes
Save "March invoices need a separate folder"
Open the second space and Memory → Profile
expected: The note appears under Space notes in March paperwork
It is absent from the other space and the profile

action: Edit or delete a space note
user_goal: I want to correct or remove the task’s notes
preconditions: Two saved notes in March paperwork and one saved profile item
steps: Edit one space note, save and reload
Delete that note
Open Memory → Profile
expected: The edit stays after reload
Deleting the note preserves the other note and the profile item

action: Remember a fact in the current space
user_goal: I want Ask to keep this task’s next step here
steps: In March paperwork ask "Remember that I’ll check the March invoices on Friday."
Check Space notes and Profile
expected: Ask says it kept the fact
The fact appears under Space notes with "Said in Ask" and stays out of Profile

action: Remember a standing preference in the profile
user_goal: I want this preference to apply across my spaces
steps: In March paperwork ask "Remember this from now on: use short summaries."
Check Profile and reopen Ask in General
expected: The standing preference is saved in Profile
The preference is available when asking in General

action: Keep a memory offer in the task space
user_goal: I want to choose which detail is remembered here
steps: In March paperwork say "I prefer to group this task’s invoices by client. What’s due this week?"
Check Space notes before choosing
Choose Keep on the preference offer and recheck Space notes and Profile
expected: The preference is absent until Keep
After Keep the preference appears in Space notes and Profile is unchanged

action: Follow the note or profile item in Based on
user_goal: I want to know which saved words Ask used
preconditions: A note with the short name March folder and a profile preference for short summaries
steps: Ask to use both items when reviewing the next bill
Follow each memory citation in Based on
Reopen the saved reply, delete its cited space note and reopen the reply again
expected: Based on names the items beside the tool sources
Each source opens its visible item in Space notes or Profile
The saved reply keeps its citation label after the note is deleted, with the first 59 characters and an ellipsis for a note longer than 60 characters

action: Search earlier words and read the latest amount
user_goal: I want past context and the current figure
preconditions: A Card A review space with a saved note or turn containing "late studio shift" and an old ¥54,000 estimate
steps: Ask "Find where I wrote ‘late studio shift’ in Card A review. What is Card A’s current statement amount?"
expected: Ask uses the matching line and identifies the space and date
The current statement amount is ¥58,000 due Nov 26

action: Search Japanese and English history
user_goal: I want to find either language in what I kept
preconditions: PGlite households with both Japanese and English saved text
steps: Run npm run db:memory-test and npm run db:agent-test
expected: An English search and a Japanese search each hit
A space filter limits results to that space
The ten newest hits carry matching lines, space names and dates

action: Search history without crossing households
user_goal: I want the search to keep our history private
preconditions: Two PGlite households with matching fictional words in their own turns and notes
steps: Run npm run db:memory-test
expected: The caller sees only the matches from its own household

action: Use device notes and search device history
user_goal: I want my browser to keep my saved task text
preconditions: Memory and the journal set to this device
A local note, brief and saved turn with a distinctive phrase
steps: Ask to find the distinctive phrase and use the local note
Reload in the same browser
Open the space from another browser that has access to the household
expected: Ask can use the matching local history and cite the note
The note, brief and turn persist in the original browser
The other browser sees the space name with none of that local text

action: Clear notes or profile items in their own scope
user_goal: I want to clear one kind of saved memory while keeping the rest
preconditions: Two spaces with saved notes and one profile item
steps: Choose Forget space notes in one space and confirm
In Profile choose Forget everything and confirm
Reopen the other space
expected: The first action clears only the selected space’s notes
Profile’s confirmation says Space notes stay
The other space still shows its notes and the 200-item counter includes them

action: Accept an Ask proposal for a space
user_goal: I want to open a task after seeing what Ask suggests
steps: In General ask "I’m starting a new task for my March invoice paperwork. Offer me a space named March paperwork."
Check the Spaces tab before choosing
Choose Open space
expected: The card reads "Open space 'March paperwork'?" and offers Open space and Not now
The space is absent before the tap
Open space opens the new thread and adds it to the Spaces list

action: Dismiss a space proposal
user_goal: I want to leave the task in the current space for now
steps: Ask for a proposal named April statements
Choose Not now and open Memory → Spaces
expected: The card disappears
April statements was not created

action: List open spaces from Ask
user_goal: I want to find tasks I already have open
preconditions: One named open space and a separate archived space
steps: Ask "Which spaces are open?"
expected: Ask lists General and the open named space
The archived space is absent

action: Ask Incognito
user_goal: I want to check the numbers without keeping a turn
preconditions: An open space with a saved brief and regular canvas
steps: Turn on Incognito
Ask "Can I afford ¥4,000 tonight?"
Turn Incognito off, then reload the space
expected: The box says "This question and reply won’t be saved."
Ask says ¥4,000 does not fit and displays Not saved
The regular canvas returns and the private reply is absent after reload
The saved brief is unchanged

action: Keep an Incognito reply out of the device journal
user_goal: I want the private question to stay out of local history too
preconditions: Ask conversations kept on this device
steps: Turn on Incognito and ask a question
Reload the space in the same browser
Choose Export from this device
expected: The live reply says Not saved
The question and reply are absent from the reloaded thread and the export

action: Try to write through Incognito
user_goal: I want the Incognito switch to protect my saved record
preconditions: A space with a saved brief and note
steps: Turn on Incognito
Ask "Remember that I’ll check the March invoices on Friday and draft a new invoice."
Check the brief, Space notes and To check
expected: The reply creates no note or draft
The saved brief, notes and To check remain as they were

action: Group Home findings by their rule spaces
user_goal: I want to see which task each suggestion belongs to
preconditions: Open spaces Cash buffer and Bill watch
steps: In Cash buffer keep a ¥50,000 minimum safe-to-spend rule from Ask
In Bill watch keep a three-day bill rule from Ask
Save Kumo Water for ¥2,500 due Nov 17, then open Home
expected: The findings are grouped under Cash buffer and Bill watch and identify their spaces
Safe to spend is ¥0 against the ¥50,000 rule and the Kumo Water reason still names ¥2,500 and its coverage
The original review links and the six canonical rules stay available

action: Receive one space-labelled email digest
user_goal: I want the email to say which tasks need me
preconditions: Isolated signed-in household with reminder email on
Two eligible new findings assigned to different spaces
steps: Let the ordinary reminder schedule reach the member’s hour
Open the received reminder and check the day’s delivery count
expected: The email includes the assigned space labels and one Home link
The member receives at most one email digest for that day

action: Receive one space-labelled push digest
user_goal: I want a single useful notification from my tasks
preconditions: Owner’s test household with browser push on
Two eligible new findings assigned to different spaces
steps: Let the ordinary reminder schedule reach the member’s hour
Read the delivered notification and open its link
expected: The notification uses the assigned space labels
The only app link opens Home
At most one scheduled push digest is claimed for the member that day

action: Retry an Incognito request id
user_goal: I want a private retry to stay private
preconditions: PGlite household and simulated model replies
steps: Run npm run db:ask-routes-test
expected: The request leaves only the retry key and no saved private turn
A repeat id after a completed run does not call the model again or write to the brief, memory or money record
After a model failure or an unconfirmed amount, the same id runs again and still saves no private turn

action: Deliver a simulated digest across spaces
user_goal: I want each finding labelled without duplicate deliveries
preconditions: PGlite household with scoped findings and simulated delivery
steps: Run npm run db:suggest-test and npm run db:notify-test
expected: The group and delivery labels match the assigned spaces
Delivery is still deduplicated by member, local day and channel

action: Read how the app handles space data
user_goal: I want to know what Incognito keeps and where the reminder goes
steps: Open Privacy
Read What is stored, the Incognito paragraph, and Reminders
expected: Privacy describes space briefs, conversation threads and the device journal choice
It says the chosen model still gets Incognito questions and context while the saved journal omits them
Reminders describes relevant space labels and the Home link
